description: Non-Major Safety and Security Events (FRA Commuter Rail Only) is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Public Transit", published or maintained by Federal Transit Administration. Counts of Non-Major Safety and Security Events are reported to the National Transit Database on a monthly basis, by transit agency and transit mode. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Public Transit". It has 29 columns, among them Customer Injuries, Additional Assault Information, End Date, Start Date, Non-Major Physical Assaults on Operators, Non-Major Non-Physical Assaults on Operators. The portal shows 2026-09-04 as the last data update. Attribution given: Federal Transit Administration. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
